# cpanel_ssl_certificates (Data Source)

Reads the complete stored public SSL certificate metadata inventory without exposing certificate PEM or private-key material.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_ssl_certificates" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `certificates` (Attributes List) The stored certificates sorted by cPanel identifier. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--certificates))

<a id="nestedatt--certificates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `certificates`

Read-Only:

- `created` (Number) The creation time as a Unix timestamp.
- `domain_is_configured` (Boolean) Whether cPanel reports a configured domain.
- `domains` (List of String) The certificate domains in sorted order.
- `ecdsa_curve_name` (String) The ECDSA curve name, or `null` when not applicable.
- `friendly_name` (String) The certificate display name.
- `id` (String) The certificate identifier assigned by cPanel.
- `installed` (Boolean) Whether an installed SSL host references the certificate.
- `is_self_signed` (Boolean) Whether cPanel reports the certificate as self-signed.
- `issuer_common_name` (String) The issuer common name, when reported.
- `key_algorithm` (String) The public-key algorithm, when reported.
- `modulus_length` (Number) The RSA modulus length, or `null` when not applicable.
- `not_after` (Number) The validity end as a Unix timestamp.
- `not_before` (Number) The validity start as a Unix timestamp.
- `serial` (String) The certificate serial, when reported.
- `signature_algorithm` (String) The signature algorithm, when reported.
- `subject_common_name` (String) The subject common name, when reported.
- `validation_type` (String) The validation type, when reported.
